questions.prompt: A domain has `MX 10 a.example.com.` and `MX 50 b.example.com.`. Which host does a sender try first?
options: a, because lower priority numbers are preferred

questions.prompt: Two MX records with the same priority share the mail between them.
What's the reverse lookup name for the address 198.51.100.7? (write the full name)
Why are the octets written backwards under in-addr.arpa?
options: Because of byte order on Intel processors
DNS names get more specific to the left, addresses to the right, so reversing lets the owner of a block be delegated its part of the tree
